root.label: Obamacare $500 refund checks begin in 30 states

events.label: Obamacare $500 refund checks begin in 30 states

slots.name: refund amount
slots.sentence: "With this Historic Action, my Administration is taking the surplus funds that accumulated from the Obamacare 'Premium Tax' and issuing a one-time $500 REFUND to Americans who use the HealthCare.gov platform to purchase their health insurance, but who do not receive Taxpayer Subsidies to help pay for their Coverage.

slots.name: refund recipients
slots.sentence: The Trump administration is issuing refund checks to about 1 million Americans, accompanied by a personal letter from President Donald Trump, to people the administration says were overcharged for Obamacare.

slots.name: drug manufacturers
slots.sentence: The administration official noted to Fox News Digital Trump's negotiations with 26 pharmaceutical manufacturers to drop the cost of drugs to prices similar to other developed nations.

slots.name: income eligibility range
slots.sentence: which was supposed to be issued to people who purchased a healthcare plan through the ACA, have an income between 100% and 400% over the poverty line and do not qualify for other government healthcare programs like Medicare and Medicaid.

slots.name: Texas recipients
slots.sentence: The top three states for refunds are Texas, with 139,000 estimated to receive the checks; Florida, at 127,900; and Ohio at 65,700.

slots.name: North Carolina recipients
slots.sentence: An estimated 58,200 will receive a $500 refund and letter in North Carolina and 55,100 in Michigan.

slots.name: excluded states
slots.sentence: The 20 states where residents will not receive a check all had their own state-run processes and did not rely on the federal exchange that the administration claims was responsible for overcharging on user fees.
